title: Levensomstandigheden in een arme stadswijk van Jakarta 1981
authors: Bianpoen, Centre for urban and environmental research and development * Jakarta (primary investigator)
contributors: Centre for urban and environmental research * Jakarta (research initiator)
Centre for urban and environmental research * Jakarta (data collector)
descriptions: Socio-economic and demographic analysis of a Jakarta neighbourhood. Family composition / socio-economic condition: income, education and schooling, expenditure on food, education, housing, health, transport, clothing / health situation / housing situation ( detailed ) / attitudes regarding job improvement, income increase, educational improvement, environmental and housing improvement / sanitary facilities / opinions on government role in improving living conditions / priorities for improvement / detailed data on food for children under 5. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education
